title: ClearPath Managed IT Services Terms of Service: First-Response Service Credits
content:
### 1. Breach of a first-response guarantee

A first-response guarantee is breached when the coverage minutes elapsed between the ticket's opening (or the raise of its priority) and its first response exceed the response target of the priority in force at first response (the P1, P2, P3 or P4 response guarantee of the tier). Coverage minutes count only time inside the tier's coverage window and exclude observed holidays where the tier excludes them. Resolution targets are objectives and never earn credits.

### 2. When a breach earns a credit

A breach earns a service credit only when all of the following hold: the tier makes service credits available, the priority is listed among the tier's credit-earning priorities, the ticket's scope determination is covered, and the client claims it.

### 3. Claim window

3.1 The credit must be claimed no later than the tier's claim window in calendar days after the first response is recorded on the ticket.

3.2 The window is counted in calendar days from the date part of the first-response timestamp, that date being day 0, and a claim made on the last day of the window is timely. The clock starts from the first response as recorded in the ticket history of that same ticket.

3.3 Boundary cases (hypothetical 30-day window, first response recorded on 2025-06-10 at 16:40): a claim on 2025-07-10 (day 30) is timely; a claim on 2025-07-11 (day 31) is not.

### 4. One credit per ticket

A ticket earns at most one service credit; a ticket that already carries a service credit on the billing ledger earns no further credit.

### 5. Amount and monthly cap

5.1 Each credited ticket earns the tier's credit per breach, a percent of the fee billed for the service month in which the ticket was opened, rounded half up to the cent. The fee billed for a service month is the monthly fee of that month; where no monthly fee exists for that month, it is the proration charge billing the initial baseline seat addition for that month.

5.2 Total credits for one service month never exceed the tier's monthly cap percent of that month's fee. The credits already counted against the cap are the service credits whose service month is that month. A credit that would pass the cap is reduced to the remaining headroom, none being posted once the cap is reached.

5.3 Hypothetical figures: a 4000.00 month on a tier crediting 4 percent with a 20 percent cap. Each credit is 160.00; the cap is 800.00. With 720.00 already credited for the month, the next credit is reduced to 80.00; with 800.00 already credited, none is posted.

### 6. Application and status

The credit is applied to the next monthly invoice posted after the claim. A credit may be posted only while the agreement status is active, suspended, notice given or offboarding. Credits are never paid out in cash and are forfeited when the agreement closes.

These terms apply on every ClearPath Managed IT Services tier, each with its own availability, percentage, cap and claim window.
